name: type:bug
description: Proven unexpected behavior; severity is separate.

name: priority:p0

name: severity:s1
description: Critical: verified exposure, data loss or complete outage. Bugs only; not clinical severity.

name: severity:s2
description: High: major capability broken without a safe workaround. Bugs only; not clinical severity.

name: severity:s3
description: Moderate: limited failure or safe workaround available. Bugs only; not clinical severity.

name: severity:s4
description: Minor impact: cosmetic or low-impact defect. Bugs only; not clinical severity.
